mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of UNRATE > 5.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 12-month averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days via earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of HOUST and RSAFS > 12mo avg periods, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 120 (INDPRO) during manufacturing expansion regimes signals rising output capacity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through profit growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of INDPRO > 120 periods, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 200.0 (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating price pressures, prompting Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL > 200.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
